name: EdgeOne Makers
line: Build and host static sites, edge functions, and cloud functions.

free.text: Static 5GB/20k files; 500 builds/mo; Functions 1M requests/500k GB-s

cells.regions: China, global network and other listed regions

work.math: 20 builds of 5 minutes fit 500 a month, with a 20-minute limit per build. Files must be up to 25 MB each, up to 20k in total, and within 5 GB of account storage.
1 million requests and 250,000 GB-seconds fit within the 1 million and 500,000 GB-second grants, if each takes 250 ms at 1 GB. Retries and measured performance are not verified.
The known Makers subtotal is $0. A separate PostgreSQL and backup service is required.
